## About
Mardinly Enterprises works on engines. Diesel engines, gasoline engines, natural gas/LPG fueled engines. If your equipment has an engine and it's not running, we make the engine and operating component repairs.
We run a complete machine shop, rebuild engines, repair heavy equipment, do custom fabrication and sell new engines and generator sets. We're an authorized Perkins dealer for new engine sales, service and parts.
Owner Dave Mardinly is on-site to oversee operations and make sure the work meets the company's standards. Building relationships one job at a time, that's how he puts it.

## Services
- Heavy Equipment Repairs: Repairs, component fabrication and engine overhauls for heavy equipment.
- Generator Set Sales & Service: Generator sets sold and serviced.
- Custom Fabrication Services: Custom fabrication and repairs done in our shop.
- Transportation-Hauling Services: Transportation and hauling to and from our shop.
- Field/Site Repairs/Services Provided: We come to the equipment when it can't come to us.
- Machine Shop Services: A complete machine shop for engine remanufacturing.
- Automotive & Truck Repairs: Repair work on cars and trucks.
- PA State Inspection Facility: Pennsylvania state inspections done here.

## FAQ
Q: What kinds of engines do you work on?
A: Diesel, gasoline and natural gas/LPG fueled engines.

Q: Do you tow or haul vehicles and equipment?
A: Yes. We handle towing, hauling and emergency recovery.

Q: What areas do you haul in?
A: Pennsylvania, New Jersey, Delaware, Maryland and parts of the New York markets.

Q: Where is the shop?
A: Inside the Broomall Industrial Park.
